title: Experiment: a file-routed MDX document is compiled into the build and does not reflect an edit
summary: An `app/doc/page.mdx` containing a mapped component built as a static route under `next build`. With `next start` serving it, the file was rewritten with a different marker and re-requested: the served page continued to show the build-time marker.

omissions.reason: DEC-0019's contract was deliberately NOT applied here, because it could not help: the document becomes JavaScript at build time, so there is no request-time read for `connection()` to make dynamic. Measuring it would have confirmed the same value for a different reason and invited the wrong conclusion.

notes: ⚠️ FOUND BY LOOKING AT THE ROUTE SYMBOL, not by asking the question. The accepted case built as `○ /doc` — static — which is the symbol AST-0019 is about, and the freshness matrix had already made it worth chasing.
